ticket.summary: Kitchen sink (both basins) draining very slowly; other fixtures unaffected — kitchen branch line clog needing snaking.

quote_lines.description: Kitchen/bath drain snaking — clear kitchen branch line serving both basins

ticket.customer_message: Good news — both basins slow points to the shared kitchen branch line, not your main sewer, so it's a straightforward snaking job. I can get a tech out tomorrow, Tue Sep 1 at 10:30 AM. Flat rate is $179 (DRAIN-SNAKE-KITCHEN), about an hour, no after-hours fee. In the meantime, go easy on the sink and skip the chemical drain cleaners. I've got you penciled in for 10:30 AM — just reply if you'd prefer the 3:00 PM window instead.
